motions.purpose: Show the order of computation in a feed-forward network: activations settle layer by layer, driven by weighted links.
motions.model: Real matrix arithmetic (weights x activations + bias through tanh) over seeded pseudo-random weights; the structure is honest, the weights are not trained.
motions.limitations: Weights are illustrative, not learned; no training dynamics, no backpropagation, no claim about any specific model's behavior.
motions.reducedMotion: Render the fully settled forward pass immediately; all activation values and link weights remain readable.
motions.exportState: Settle every layer, hide controls, keep the illustrative truth badge visible.
motions.accessibility: SVG has a summary aria-label; controls are native buttons and a labelled slider; Escape stops the sequence; sign is encoded by color and dash style redundantly.

motions.purpose: Let the presenter scale the input vector and watch activations respond, demonstrating sensitivity rather than a trained mapping.
motions.model: Same seeded feed-forward arithmetic; the slider multiplies a fixed input vector.
motions.limitations: Sensitivity shown is that of random weights; do not read scientific meaning into specific output values.
motions.reducedMotion: Values update instantly with no pulse animation.
motions.exportState: Freeze at slider value 0.8 with all layers settled.
motions.accessibility: Slider is a native labelled range input; activation values are rendered as text when showValues is enabled.
